# AI in Finance Daily — 2026-11-27

*Wall Street cranks up 2027 price targets — while quietly shoving AI loan risk off its own books.*

## 🔎 The lead
**Banks are offloading AI credit before it bites.** Citigroup and JPMorgan are reportedly shopping AI-linked loans to shift risk off their balance sheets, even as JPMorgan maps a looming $450B AI debt wave and warns credit risks are mounting [66](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizAFBVV95cUxPMG1yQWdEVVdqYWxkQ2FsWm9EbHpjdmF5RDQ5aXNxR2gwUWVFN25nVnZ2QTJFNHFnU0ZrREQyYlpfWUdicE9lSEY5ZGd4TzM4Tjg0SFlTRENYX3lIOWd1R0lHQnZ1dVBfeThUSW9LQURFSGJ6NklJZ2pvcnhJMXprNEYwYjFnV2JRdW5QVjlrU3VOUFdMMmRYVktPS1dMcDNESTJsQzVMS2hWNWtROGlSNnNOV011bjRxVW5saFhVQ2hURjB6N2xub0dQaWg?oc=5), [99](https://news.google.?oc=5). The bank's own analysts split AI credit into two buckets: Big Tech's fortress balance sheets versus the riskier debt stacking up at the periphery [105](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxPYnlrR2x6d0V3UnNFekF3SG5kdF9wYWxSeGtEX29GVUc0c2JsSHhYR2R3RG1WRklPdVJvVTB3azhwNGliYUFKdjZpV2pyU1lXdG9kT252M2kweFMxSl9OX09JVFVQVEt2NjluU3plQlVpZ3BHUjlYZGExZ002XzJQMUM1aWRNcnpQSm9OZktNYXl0dFpqeUJoM1ZyRXJobWlVY19Wa3A5MU4?oc=5). Independent estimates put the total AI debt burden near $5 trillion [104](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijwFBVV95cUxQYzMzRThpekQ3U0pPQ2JVd3hTN2JoQkJ2bUpiUHNIQlpNNFZDOWNQQWdaZENoanVBRENpaDY2VDdfSXc1Q1BiNWNtRVItTTFDd29pUEtHb0VDSWVGTE1tV21yWmI3RWJzZVZuNlEtWGVGamxtbU13T0pzQ0hNSXgtdFFWUURrenNkc0ZXdWFlMA?oc=5). **So what:** When originators start distributing the paper rather than holding it, that's the tell — they want someone else holding the bag if the capex cycle turns.

## ⚡ The big picture
**Sell-side cranks 2027 targets.** Deutsche Bank sees the S&P 500 at 9,000 by end-2027, calling the tech rout close to a bottom; JPMorgan pegs 8,200 [65](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWkFVX3lxTFBOeHMyNnZNTksxbDZBcmdlbW1ySlZaRFg2S0Nmb21xLWgwS1JLYzZFUnc5dkc3ZmotYWVMS1pjbmZwRWZ4WEw5c3VuQ3NpLWZ2TjVTODk0N0lqUQ?oc=5), [68](https://news.google.?oc=5). The gap between these bulls and the credit warnings above is the trade of 2027.

**Goldman calls the selling bottom.** Five straight weeks of hedge-fund de-grossing is nearly done, while retail and retirement funds bucked the trend with $150B of inflows [12](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidkFVX3lxTE1MZ2xKSEpOWmo2RDd1QXBXVExOU2dmS2RIU2V3Mk1zcVlXQ19lTXRQX3NRdlVZX0VvOUM5bGdLbmVHUDdDQVBYZ1hmMTh5N2lUOWVjQWNMOVNCY2tpNUdYYS1XZTUtSzFabkdaMkdRWnF2eWtCNFE?oc=5). **So what:** Smart money sold, dumb money bought — and the dumb money may be winning.

**JPMorgan's jobs warning.** The bank's wealth arm says AI could put 24 million knowledge-worker jobs at risk over five years [73](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5).

**FAB goes AI-native.** First Abu Dhabi Bank launched FAB First, a conversational AI-native banking app — Gulf banks keep front-running Western peers on consumer deployment [60](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxOT21TUTRjb2ptNVdUa2FVeTE2SVlMTmxydDVWRVhNOVRGTHpPVXFmdmRQbEpyN2hwVTVBSGRrbVNMaFl6VEVNUmRDZWtnN3VsVGc2bjVJZkJPTWNFNTB3S3F1WDRPUXZFelNqMU4zelY4WXpvdUo0NFVlUXltN1k0OGR6b3NzbDVWMno2aW1MQWVXMlZJcDlndU9lSQ?oc=5).

**HSBC cuts with AI.** The bank is consolidating India finance roles as AI-driven cost cuts accelerate [71](https://news.google.?oc=5) — the jobs warning, in practice.
